ESLint unbound-method required retaining its descriptor instead and invoking descriptor.get.call(buffer). The native intrinsic, receiver, policy, and every row-loop operation are unchanged; source bytes differ. No post-observation performance tuning. Hosted timing must identify the checked source separately.
